name: SU-35
desc: Sukhoi Su-35 is a deeply modernized derivative of the Su-27 platform, designed for air superiority and multirole missions. It features thrust-vectoring engines, advanced Irbis-E radar, and improved avionics, enabling extreme maneuverability and long-range engagement. Classified as a 4++ generation fighter, it bridges the gap toward fifth-generation capabilities without full stealth design.

name: C-130
desc: Lockheed C-130 Hercules is a versatile tactical transport aircraft capable of operating from short and unprepared runways. It is widely used for cargo transport, troop deployment, medical evacuation, and special operations. Its adaptability has led to numerous variants including gunships and firefighting aircraft.

name: C-17
desc: Boeing C-17 Globemaster III is a strategic airlifter designed for rapid deployment of troops and heavy equipment worldwide. It combines high payload capacity with the ability to operate on short runways, making it essential for both military logistics and humanitarian missions.

name: C-5
desc: Lockheed C-5 Galaxy is one of the largest military transport aircraft in the world. It is capable of carrying oversized cargo, including tanks and helicopters, across intercontinental distances. Its distinctive nose-loading system enables rapid loading operations.

name: F-16
desc: F-16 Fighting Falcon is a highly maneuverable multirole fighter widely used by NATO and allied countries. It was one of the first aircraft to use fly-by-wire control systems and remains a backbone of many air forces due to its versatility and cost-effectiveness.

name: TU-160
desc: Tupolev Tu-160 is the largest and fastest supersonic strategic bomber in service. It features variable-sweep wings and is capable of carrying nuclear and conventional cruise missiles over intercontinental distances.

name: E-3
desc: E-3 Sentry is an airborne early warning and control aircraft equipped with a rotating radar dome. It provides long-range surveillance, command, and control functions for air operations.

name: B-52
desc: B-52 Stratofortress is a long-range subsonic bomber capable of delivering both nuclear and conventional weapons. Despite its age, it remains a key component of U.S. strategic deterrence.

name: P-3C
desc: P-3 Orion is a maritime patrol aircraft designed for anti-submarine warfare, reconnaissance, and surveillance missions over oceans.

name: B-1B
desc: B-1B Lancer is a supersonic variable-sweep wing bomber optimized for low-altitude penetration and high payload delivery.

name: E-8
desc: E-8 Joint STARS is an airborne command, control, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (C2ISR) platform designed to track ground targets and provide real-time battlefield management data to commanders.

name: TU-22M
desc: Tu-22M is a supersonic long-range bomber with variable-sweep wings designed for maritime strike and nuclear delivery missions.

name: F-15
desc: F-15 Eagle is a highly successful air superiority fighter known for its speed, radar capabilities, and unmatched air-to-air combat record.

name: KC-135
desc: KC-135 Stratotanker is an aerial refueling aircraft that extends the operational range of U.S. and allied military aircraft.

name: F-22
desc: F-22 Raptor is a fifth-generation stealth fighter with advanced avionics, supercruise capability, and unmatched air superiority performance.

name: FA-18
desc: F/A-18 Hornet is a carrier-capable multirole fighter used for both air-to-air and air-to-ground missions by the U.S. Navy.

name: TU-95
desc: Tu-95 is a long-range strategic bomber powered by turboprop engines, known for its distinctive contra-rotating propellers and nuclear strike capability.

name: KC-10
desc: KC-10 Extender is a strategic aerial refueling and cargo aircraft capable of supporting long-range deployment operations.

name: SU-34
desc: Su-34 is a strike fighter designed for deep penetration missions with heavy payload capacity and advanced targeting systems.

name: SU-24
desc: Su-24 is an all-weather attack aircraft with variable-sweep wings, designed for low-level penetration and precision strikes.
